reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every weekend/holiday path (getNextDate, the schedules app handlers, the budget schedule template via getDateWithSkippedWeekend) already uses.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is one extra includes in the single predicate.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule is edited where it is defined, in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Predicate, a type comment, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: The predicate stays short and readable, with the two accepted formats documented at the definition and on the type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No caller matches holidays on its own; all go through isNonWorkingDay.
